name: Verify assistant creates incident after gathering information and confirmation
objective: Validate that the AI Assistant gathers required information, presents a summary, and creates an incident only after user confirmation.
precondition: User is logged in, on home page, AI Assistant panel is open.

steps.description: Click the Agentforce icon on the home page
Describe an issue to the assistant
steps.testData: "My email is not working since this morning"
steps.expectedResult: The assistant acknowledges the issue and may ask for more details

steps.description: Provide additional details as requested by the assistant
steps.expectedResult: The assistant gathers all required information

steps.description: Verify the assistant presents a summary before creation
steps.expectedResult: A summary of the incident is displayed showing description, category, and other fields

steps.description: Verify the incident number is displayed
steps.expectedResult: An incident number (e.g., INC-XXXXX) is displayed

steps.description: Verify a link to the incident record is provided
steps.expectedResult: A clickable link to the created incident record is shown
